Docker Sandboxes re-resolves saved mount paths when replacing a sandbox container during kit changes or restarting a sandbox. An attacker able to replace a source ancestor in a shared writable workspace with a symlink can redirect another sandbox's mount to a different host directory, exposing its contents and permitting modification through read-write mounts. The destination must remain accessible to the daemon and allowed by policy where enforced. Saved-mount replay during kit replacement was introduced in version 0.35.0; ordinary restart replay was added in version 0.45.0. This saved-mount replay issue is fixed in version 0.54.0. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Gravedad 4.0 5.30 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

A vulnerability was identified in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. This impacts the function hpm_adc_enabled of the file bsp/hpmicro/libraries/drivers/drv_adc.c of the component HPM ADC Driver. The manipulation of the argument channel leads to improper validation of array index. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The identifier of the patch is fc64f78669b42b35981f97c23c7e952832f3b48b. LibreChat 0.7.6 before 0.8.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to block the server event loop by uploading a crafted conversation import file to POST /api/convos/import.
